svg.aria-label: Sinusoidal positional encoding in three panels. A heatmap of the encoding table shows banded stripes that are narrow in the low embedding dimensions and wide in the high ones. Three sinusoids plotted against position have wavelengths of roughly 6, 63 and 628 positions, a decade apart. One sine-cosine dimension pair is plotted on the unit circle, where successive positions step around it by a constant angle, so a fixed offset k is the same rotation wherever it starts.
svg.title: Sinusoidal positional encoding
